description: As the new school year approaches, State Senator Pam Helming is voicing strong opposition to a proposed rule by the New York State Education Department that would mandate schools to allow boys to participate on girls’ sports teams when an equivalent boys’ team does not exist. The rule, if approved by the Board of Regents in September, could take effect later this month.In a column published this week, Helming, who represents New York’s 54th District, argues that the proposed gender-neutral rule
title: Sen. Helming Urges Protection of Girls’ Sports Ahead of Board of Regents Vote
